
  The prerequisite tickets and dependency chain are now planned, but FRE-1611 itself still has a stale plan: it assumes executable source commands already exist. It should be replanned after FRE-1711
  defines the actual command/report interface.

  Next step: implement FRE-1711 (https://linear.app/freshclaim/issue/FRE-1711/make-the-typescript-directory-collector-executable).

  That establishes the contract everything else needs:

  1. TypeScript/Bun command entrypoint in services/directory
  2. DI composition root for Postgres, evidence storage, HTTP/proxy transport, config, logging
  3. bounded inputs, persisted accounting, resume/lease semantics, sanitized terminal reports
  4. fixture-mode command tests

  Then implement FRE-1712 and FRE-1713 in parallel or sequence, using that runtime. Once their command contracts are stable, replan and resume FRE-1611 to add the Kestra image runtime, YAML flows,
  secret bindings, schedules, alerts, and staging dry-run.

  One administrative cleanup remains: the blocked FRE-1611 draft PR should be closed or clearly marked blocked, since it contains no implementation.
